summary: Converge the current ticket index across bounded archive locator changes

delivery.outcome: Continue existing PLF-20292 by making bounded current-index finalization converge across canonical archive/locator changes during rebuild. Independently publish and qualify sustained installed/runtime writer behavior before claiming resolution.
nonGoals: No physical active/history authority migration, larger repair budgets, foreground full scan, weakened freshness or lock deletion.
No unrelated metadata/version, execution/admission, publication policy or preserved foreign ticket263 changes.

architecture.decision: Capture a bounded locator map only when its source signature is stable and matches the pre-scan generation. During existing locked finalization, include exact locator-delta identities alongside changed canonical sources/evidence and resolve canonical current/locator/fallback precedence under unchanged byte/time/ticket budgets. Missing or ambiguous baseline, malformed/oversize locator, external races and excessive work remain stale. Do not turn an observation into an execution claim.
architecture.rollback: Revert governed source and replace only independently approved exact Native target if required; retain authoritative YAML/evidence, locator, current owners and disposable index.

validation.evidence: Independent canonical writer rotates/reopens and changes locator during every scan; one bounded rebuild converges for flat/sharded stores, preserving canonical payload and exact-once index IDs.
Ambiguous/missing locator baseline, excessive bytes/identities/time, invalid locator and source races fail closed; unrelated history is not parsed; indexed discovery remains current/readonly.

commands: protected exact-head/current-base OneDev and independent Validator
installed artifact qualification and separately fenced Native readback
validation.evidence: Source merge, installed candidate and live sustained currentness are separately recorded; peers, automation and authoritative data are preserved.
